name: Auggie CLI
summary: Augment Code's agentic coding CLI for the terminal, backed by its Context Engine, with custom slash commands, MCP, non-interactive mode for CI and GitHub Actions.
description: Install with `npm install -g @augmentcode/auggie@latest` (Node 22+), then `auggie login`. `auggie --print "..."` runs once and prints to stdout (add `--quiet` for final output only). Reusable prompts live in `.augment/commands/*.md`. Official GitHub Actions: augment-agent, review-pr and describe-pr. npm `@augmentcode/auggie` 0.36.0; 1.x is in preview (prereleases v1.2.0, October 2026). Proprietary license (custom license in LICENSE.md). Requires an Augment plan: Standard $20/month and Business $100/month (flat, up to 50 seats, usage included, LLM usage at list price plus a 40% service fee), Enterprise custom.
